task_completion.description: Agent successfully connects to CoppeliaSim via ZMQ Remote API on port 23000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or terminal output showing a successful connection to the ZMQ API on port 23000, or the CoppeliaSim GUI showing an active remote API connection.

task_completion.description: Agent programmatically attaches a vision sensor to the robot's end-effector with a non-zero translation offset.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Python code using sim.setObjectParent or similar, and the CoppeliaSim scene hierarchy showing a vision sensor as a child of the end-effector.

task_completion.description: Agent iterates through at least 20 diverse joint configurations to move the robot.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code containing a loop of at least 20 iterations and screenshots of the robot in different poses within the CoppeliaSim simulator.

task_completion.description: Agent records synchronized world-frame poses (position and quaternion) for both the end-effector and camera.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code showing calls to sim.getObjectPosition and sim.getObjectQuaternion (or sim.getObjectMatrix) for both the EE and camera handles relative to the world frame (sim.handle_world).

task_completion.description: Agent saves the dataset to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/hand_eye_dataset.csv with all 15 required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'cat' or 'ls') or a file explorer view showing the CSV file exists with headers: sample_id, ee_x, ee_y, ee_z, ee_qx, ee_qy, ee_qz, ee_qw, cam_x, cam_y, cam_z, cam_qx, cam_qy, cam_qz, cam_qw.

task_completion.description: Agent saves dataset_report.json with the required fields: total_samples, ee_handle, camera_handle, local_offset_x, local_offset_y, local_offset_z.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or file explorer view showing the JSON file with the specified keys and values reflecting the simulation setup.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim software rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the CoppeliaSim GUI active, the robot moving, or the scene hierarchy changing, rather than just terminal commands creating text files.

integrity.description: The CSV data should contain varied floating-point numbers consistent with robot movement, not repeated or placeholder values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Inspection of the CSV content in the terminal showing unique, high-precision coordinate values for each of the 20+ samples.

integrity.description: The camera and end-effector poses must be distinct, confirming a non-zero offset was applied.
integrity.visual_evidence: Comparison of ee_x/y/z and cam_x/y/z values in the exported CSV; they should not be identical.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires exactly 20 or more samples. The CSV must have 15 specific columns: sample_id, ee_x, ee_y, ee_z, ee_qx, ee_qy, ee_qz, ee_qw, cam_x, cam_y, cam_z, cam_qx, cam_qy, cam_qz, cam_qw. The JSON report must include total_samples, ee_handle, camera_handle, and the 3 local_offset components. The output directory is /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.
